_comment: Which key feeds which action. Key names are Bevy's KeyCode names. Axes: z is back (W is negative). deadzone (0..1) and curve apply to analog sources only (the pad, the virtual-joystick mouse); keyboard keys are digital. The same key may serve several actions. Gamepad or joystick: buttons as "Pad:<GamepadButton>" (raw: "Pad:Button<n>"), an axis per action as "pad": "<GamepadAxis>" ("-" in front inverts, raw HOTAS axes: "Axis<n>"). turn_pitch and turn_yaw are stick only; on foot the stick turns the view at pad.look_rate_deg. landing_mode: the axis model's landing mode, TODO(initiator): the key (K for now). skip_notices: runs the queued banners and toasts fast (#165). decline and next_offer: at a giver's counter (#167). map: opens the map, track_job: tracks the next active job (#166). abandon_job: drops the tracked job, pressed twice (#132), TODO(initiator): the key. turn_cap: A/B switch for the axis model's G-safety turn cap (#118). mouse.ship_mode: "vjoy" (the mouse moves a virtual stick; ship_sensitivity is radians of stick offset per pixel) or "direct" (radians of turn per pixel). flight_model (F7, round 5): the axis model or the SC model; in the SC model H switches gravity compensation, C coupled or decoupled, F8 G-safe, K landing mode; master_mode (SCM or NAV), comstab, proximity_assist, wind_comp (I; Y abandons a job) and limiter_up/limiter_down (the speed limiter) are the SC model's switches. A file that still says thrust_law keeps that key for flight_model. TODO(initiator): the SC switches' keys.
